gotchas: Reach the form from the home page: click the 'Membership / Purchase history' header link to land on Login, then click 'Create an account'. /us/en/member/register is a 404.
The form is email, password (8-20 characters, letters and numbers), an optional birthday (MM/DD/YYYY), a gender radio and two pre-checked newsletter boxes; no name or phone.
Submitting shows a verification-code field; a code sent by email belongs to the account owner: hand it off. UNIQLO and GU share one account.
Create the login with maxLength 20: the site caps passwords at 20 characters.
